The '''Institute of Xenozoology''' was a scientific institute that focused on [[xenozoology]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tobas Grell]] left some of his possessions to the Institute in his will.
